login.title: Canvas account
login.subtitle: Sign in, then connect your own Canvas access token so Claude can read Canvas as you.
login.signupsPaused: New sign-ups are paused. Existing accounts can still sign in.
login.inviteOnly: This server is invite-only. Sign in with the account the owner added.
login.consentHint: After you sign in, you will be asked to approve the app that sent you here.

noProviders.title: No sign-in method is set up
noProviders.body: The server owner has not configured a sign-in provider yet.

loadFailed.title: Could not load the sign-in options

signedOut.title: Canvas account
signedOut.body: Sign in, then add your own Canvas access token. Claude then reads Canvas as you, and only with your permission.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your account was created, but an owner has to approve it before you can add a Canvas token. Check back later.
pending.hint: Once you are approved, refresh to continue.

disabled.title: Account disabled
disabled.body: This account has been disabled, so you cannot use it right now. Contact the person who runs this server.

consent.title: Allow {{client}} to use Canvas MCP as {{name}}?
consent.intro: {{client}} is asking to connect to your Canvas MCP account.
consent.redirectHost: After you decide, you will be sent back to {{host}}.

scopes.canvas_write: Make changes in Canvas that you have enabled under write tools

invalidLink.title: This approval link is not valid
invalidLink.body: Start again from the app that sent you here.

expired.title: This request has expired
expired.body: The approval request expired or was already used. Start again from the app.

consent.badRedirect: The server returned a destination that was not safe to open, so nothing was opened.
